description: Read a Workspace: every Tile in one list, in reading order (top to bottom, then left to right), and the user's current window size. Each Tile has its kind and placement on the grid: x and w in 12 columns, y and h in rows of 8 px at the user's laptop window (1512 px wide; gaps 16 px, margins 24 px), each y being where the Tile floats up to. No h means the Tile is as tall as its Panel or Note, at most about two-thirds of the user's window height (a taller Panel scrolls inside it). With h, a Panel's Tile is that tall where its Panel is taller, and its Panel scrolls inside it; h beyond its Panel's own height is capped at that height, and the Fit report says so (capped). With h, a Note's Tile is that tall, even taller than its text. A Panel has its id, Source page, mode, state (live while it shows its content; restoring, paused, broken, ambiguous, needs-peek or not-responding otherwise) and Fit status at the user's window, as the Fit report gives it. tier says how its content was last found: exact, healed (found by similarity after a reload), ambiguous (with the candidate ids on its running page that might be it) or not-found; moved means an item-mode Panel found its content somewhere else on the page. A Note has its id, text and when it was last written. A hidden Tile is a Panel from one of the user's Private sites: only its placement, which you can't move or remove. On a Panel or Note, userChanged means the user moved or resized it since you last placed Tiles on this Workspace (with arrange, or add_panel or add_note with a placement).
name: read_workspace
